d:
"Boom Padi Deshe" celebrates the vibrant culture, unique slang, and delicious food of Gujarat. The track also highlights the sharp business mindset that defines the people of the state, blending tradition with entrepreneurial spirit to showcase what makes Gujarat truly special.
Song Credits:
Track Name: Boom Padi Dese
Written & Performed By: Mad Trip
Music Producer: Aditya Pushkarna
Primary Artist: Mad Trip
Track Name: Boom Padi Dese
Singer/Performed By/Cast: Mad Trip
